messages.subject: Including .Rnw-files in .tex-document
parts:
Hello,

I have read the tutorial on using knitr in eclipse, in there the author explains he uses a .tex-file for his main document and includes all R-Codes from an R-file (page 8). This enables him to view the outline of the document in eclipse, which is not supported for .rnw-files.

How does he do that?

I understand how I can include codes into a .Rnw-document, but how do you do it for .tex-files?
